# MONO DISTRICT. — Managed Virtual Assistant Agency (Full Reference)

---

## Specialist VA Roles We Place

### 1. Social Media Managers
Handle your day-to-day social presence: content strategy, post scheduling, basic graphic design, comment and DM community management, and performance analytics.

### 2. Graphic Designers
Create custom brand visuals: social media graphics, ad creatives, carousels, marketing flyers, pitch decks, and print or digital collateral.

### 3. Video Editors
Edit engaging video content: Instagram Reels, TikToks, YouTube videos, and paid video ads with clean cuts, captions, sound design, and strong pacing.

### 4. Web Designers / Developers
Design and build your web presence: landing pages, business websites, e-commerce storefronts (including Shopify, WordPress, and Webflow), responsive layouts, and ongoing site updates.

---

## How MONO DISTRICT. Works

1. **Choose your specialist VAs and sign an upfront NDA**: Book a free 30-minute consultation to define your daily hours (starting at 3 hours/day) and select the VA roles you need. We sign an NDA upfront before onboarding so brand files, logins, and internal data stay protected.
2. **Work through your dedicated Account Manager**: Your Account Manager replies instantly or within 1 hour the same day and relays briefs and revisions straight to your designers, editors, and developers. If you prefer to speak directly with a specialist VA, you can—your Account Manager monitors the conversation so nothing slips.
3. **Scale freely with terminable-anytime terms**: Run on flexible hourly or monthly billing with no long-term contracts. If a specialist ever is not the right fit for your brand or pace, we replace them promptly at no extra cost while your Account Manager retains full project history.

## Commercial Terms & SLAs
- **Minimum Commitment**: 3 hours/day (15 hours/week)
- **Billing Options**: Hourly or monthly fixed custom rate; card or bank transfer
- **Contract Length**: Terminable anytime; zero long-term lock-in
- **Account Manager Response Time**: Instant to within 1 hour the same day
- **Revision Turnaround**: Typically within 24 hours
- **Static Graphics & Social Copy Turnaround**: 24 to 48 business hours
- **Short-Form Reels & Video Ads Turnaround**: 2 to 3 business days
- **Web Design & Development Milestones**: Shipped weekly
- **Collaboration Tools**: Google Drive, Dropbox, Figma, Frame.io, Notion, Slack, and email
- **Confidentiality**: Mutual NDA signed upfront before onboarding
- **Craft Policy**: 100% human-crafted creative and code (no AI-generated artwork; AI is used strictly internally for notes, transcription, and research)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What specialist VAs can I hire?**
A: You can hire dedicated virtual assistants in four specializations: Social Media Managers (content strategy, scheduling, basic design, community management, and analytics), Graphic Designers (social creatives, ad graphics, carousels, pitch decks, print/digital collateral), Video Editors (Reels, TikToks, YouTube edits, video ads), and Web Designers/Developers (landing pages, Shopify/WordPress/Webflow sites, custom builds).

**Q: How fast does the Account Manager reply, and can I talk to my VA directly?**
A: Your Account Manager replies instantly or within 1 hour during the same day. By default, they relay all briefs and revisions to your designers, editors, and developers. If you ever want to speak directly with a specialist VA, you can—your Account Manager simply monitors the conversation so context and accountability stay intact.

**Q: How do revisions work, and what happens if a VA isn’t a fit?**
A: Send revision notes to your Account Manager and they relay edits directly to your designer, editor, or developer—typically turned around within 24 hours. If a specialist VA ever isn’t the right match for your brand or pace, we replace them promptly at no extra cost while your Account Manager retains your full project history.

**Q: What are the minimum hours, contract length, and trial terms?**
A: Our minimum commitment is 3 hours/day (15 hours/week). Contract length fits your schedule and is terminable anytime with zero long-term lock-in—giving you a risk-free way to test the team without multi-month commitments.

**Q: How do pricing and billing work?**
A: You choose hourly or monthly billing based on your daily hours (starting at 3 hours/day) and the specialist role(s) you hire. We confirm a clear flat rate during your consultation and invoice via card or bank transfer with no hidden fees.

**Q: What are your turnaround times and collaboration tools?**
A: Static graphics and social copy deliver in 24 to 48 business hours, short-form Reels and video ads in 2 to 3 business days, and web design or development milestones ship weekly. Files and approvals run through Google Drive, Dropbox, Figma, Frame.io, or Notion, with daily communication over Slack or email.

**Q: Do you sign NDAs and use real specialists instead of AI artwork?**
A: Yes—we sign an NDA upfront before onboarding so your logins, brand files, and business data stay strictly protected. Every graphic, video edit, post, and line of code is crafted by human specialists; AI is only used internally for meeting notes, transcription, and research.
